Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, pack your pool noodles and get to the Danville docks. Doof's boarded a party cruise and my Aunt Olga is on that ship celebrating her birthday. I don't want him to ruin her big day. Stop Doof.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I have to admit, that game reminded me how important L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. is for O.W.C.A. to stay motivated. And it reminded me why I'm behind a desk now. My brain is more stable than my brawn.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we hired a professional artist and got much better results. We've identified the rogue agent as Dennis. (He flips through various disguises of a mean-looking bunny.) He's a mercenary for hire and a master of disguise. (The last picture shows the same rabbit that Candace found.) You need to stop him at all costs.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Coughs) I apologize, Agent P. I'm a little under the weather today. First, I was convinced that Carl got me sick, you know, that old knee-jerk blame Carl thing but then, then we received this, this morning.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anywho, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to something sinister. Find out what it is and report back. Monogram, out. Carl, fade out. (Carl pushes a button on a remote which turns the room pitch black, and the only things visible are the eyes of Agent P, Carl and Major Monogram) You can go, Agent P. (he does so) Okay, Carl. Turn on the lights. (pause) Carl? (man laughing manically) Stop it, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, are you familiar with the phrase, "No duh"? (to Agent P) Getting chipped could put the entire operation in danger, so avoid it by any means necessary. But it's, uh... it's always good to have a checkup.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you may know, this is International Good Manners Day. Perhaps, not ironically, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has chosen this very week to create a device that causes rampant rudeness. Go take care of it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Lawn gnomes across the Tri-State Area are disappearing, leaving thousands of gardens unprotected from the evils of black magic. We suspect Doofenshmirtz. Get right on it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Quiet, Carl! Haven't you caused enough harm? (to Perry) Your "so-called" Secret Santa must've somehow infiltrated the agency and uh, until we get to the bottom of it, whatever you do, do not play that CD.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz has been stocking up on a lot of high-end sound equipment and musical instruments. In fact, he jut outbid me on this sweet vintage solid-body maple-top guitar.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? Nothing available for tonight? Oh, never mind. (To Perry) Er, sorry, Agent P. It's date night tonight with the wife, and if I don't figure out something special to do, I'm royally in the doghouse.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (via Perry's wristwatch communicator) Agent P, you must stop Doofenshmirtz and his unnamed gang of evil scientists before they broadcast their message of evil, and interrupt what has quickly become mine and Carl's favorite show.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's shakin', bacon? (camera reveals Major Monogram dressed up '50s-style) Like the threads? Carl and I are going to cruise over to the Doo Wop Hop tonight. We're going incognito. Maybe do a little reconnaissance while I take in the car show.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Looks like we picked a bad day to send all of our field agents to sensitivity training. We're all out of options. (gasps) I was hoping this day would never come, but, Carl, this is your big chance! (Carl gets raised up on a chair as he salutes him.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. As you can see, I, uh, I've had a little shaving mishap with this defective electric razor. Just not comfortable with my eyebrows moving independently of each other.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyways, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted outside the Danville Water Park with a preposterous amount of Doonkelberry oil. Water and oil don't mix. He must be up to something nefarious.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. The evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to his old tricks. For reasons unknown to us, he's bought up 80% of the country's tin foil. (He stops, looking a bit surprised) Carl, di-didn't he already do that?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Doofenshmirtz has been seen racking up huge bills in Brain, Bath, and Beyond, the area's largest Big Box Mind Control Warehouse store. Get to the bottom of it. Monogram out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That was stupid fresh!! I'm making that one my ringtone for sure! And right now, I've got a surprise for all who have youngsters, a special guest who's got his own death theme song.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to bother you, Agent P. We just wanted to let you know we'd be temporarily unavailable. Seems there's a giant dinosaur running amok downtown and Carl wants to go check it out. (Carl leans into the frame wearing a "I Heart Dinosaurs" baseball cap.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've just heard that our New Mexico operative, Agent CH, has had his cover compromised. We have the coordinates of his location, and you are the closest agent. Get to it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is on the move. We've tracked him to northwestern Washington. We need you to get up there and see what he's up to. Oww! Oh! My back! Carl, crack!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Have a seat, Agent P. (cut to reveal Monogram on an old black and white TV set) Due to the gravity of your mission today, the gentleman on the big screen will be addressing you (Wide shot to reveal Fury on the big screen) while I use this old TV monitor Carl found in the basement.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, the constant acrobatic lessons you've been given since birth. You, Monty Monogram, don't have to give up my dream of becoming an acrobat. You can be anything you want to be.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Excellent work, young man! Excellent! Y'know, it's unprecedented, uh, you being a human, but I'd like to offer you a job at the Agency. What do you say, son? Ya wanna fight evil?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Gentlemen, we're out to stop Doofenwitch. You want to rescue the girl. I see an opportunity here for some inter-agency cooperation. Now, here's the plan. Wait, why am I a fairy?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I'm trying to use the bone. (to Perry) Anyway, Agent P, we've learned that Dr. Doofenshmirtz is shopping for parts to build another one of his outlandish devices. Put a tail on him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, Carl, they never look at the photo. Anyway, get out there, Agent P, and good luck! (Perry salutes, then leaves) And make sure you stop and smell the roses! Well. . . he never stops to smell the roses.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to do this to you, Agent P, but we're making Doofenshmirtz your responsibility during his probation period. Show him the ropes, and, uh, don't let him out of your sight.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P, We have a report that Doofenshmirtz is at the shark. We don't know which shark, but it sounds bad. Ugh! Gives me the heebie-jeebies just thinking about it...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyhow, Doofenshmirtz has gone missing. We've used our global location scout and we can't find him anywhere. Even his answering machine has given us no clue as to where he is.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ew! Agent P, you're here! We're getting very suspicious about Doofenshmirtz. He hasn't ordered any bulk items from the Internet in days. Get over there and put a start to it! (Perry salutes.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry you had to pull that all-nighter, but we really appreciate you filling in for Agent Q. With most everyone down at Agent-Con this week, we're, uh, a little shorthanded.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'll keep it brief. Doof is getting into some farm-related shenanigans, and no good has ever come from a mad scientist taking up animal husbandry. Go get him, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's not why I called you in. Get a look at this. This is Newton the Gnu. He was assigned to Dr. Diminutive, but it seems some bonehead blew his cover on the blogosphere.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. just checking in to see if you noticed any evil activity from Doofenshmirtz, (Perry looks up to Major Monogram is standing right there, with Carl holding up a backboard) there's a-- Monogram out. (He walks away) Carl, why didn't you tell me he was sitting right there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Put a sock in it, Carl! (clears throat) I, was a-a bit too busy planning your party, so I'm not sure what Doofenshmirtz is up to, but I am sure that it's no good. Get to the bottom of it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Perry) Anywho, we've had some grave concerns. Seems there's been some extreme seismic activity in the area. We're pretty sure our old friend Doofenshmirtz is up to no good again.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Stops video) You see that? Dr. Doofenshmirtz saving a kitten. Looks like he's defecting to the good side! Make contact and present him with our standard welcome package. Monogram out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, yes-yes, of course. Bad news is the relocation, and the good news is the new villain thing. Uh… just make sure you take your belongings from the house when you leave. (Perry looks away, depressed.)

Name: Major Monogram (2nd Dimension)
Dialog: Oh, you're from another dimension? Well, he'll probably want to see you then - he's into that freaky sorta stuff. Have a seat and I'll let him know you're on your way up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, it's a lovely tie, but I'm not your father! (to Perry) Anywho, Doofenshmirtz has plans to gum up the entire Tri-State Area. And we need you to check it out. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm sorry, Agent P. Carl's an extra in some Christmas show, and I don't know what Doof is doing today. You know what, I'm just gonna send you over there blind. (salutes) Good luck.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, umm... that's a lot lower on my heebie-jeebie scale. So Agent P, uh, change of plans. Head over to the park and stop Doof from doing the doings that Doof does ...do (Clears throat)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Lucky dog. It's cold in... Oh! Agent P! Didn't hear you come in. I have no idea what Doofenshmirtz is up to. It seems all of our computers froze. Isn't that right, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, yes, here it is. Dr. Doofenshmirtz. Huh, what a surprise. Building some sort of destructo ray. End of the world. Yadda, yadda, yadda. I'm faxing you the coordinates.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, an unusual power wave has struck the city with potentially disastrous consequences. Forget Doofenshmirtz, find the source of that power wave, and dismantle it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get out of here! (Doofenshmirtz and Perry leave and Carl walks by with a mail cart) Carl, get in here! When you're done delivering the mail, I want you to wash and wax my car. You know, a little wax on, wax off? It'll teach you karate!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay then, let's throw it over to my partner in crime. Not that I'd actually perpetrate a crime with him of course, I-I would never... (at Carl) Carl! Who wrote these cue cards?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I hope you enjoyed Lair Entrance: The Ride. The agency wanted to make coming into work more exciting. It was either that or a huge bonus check.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, as you know, my father was in the agency, and what you don't know is that he pressured me into following in his footsteps. But I always wanted to be an acrobat!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. Look, here's the thing, I don't know what Doof is up to. I've been busy giving each of my friends personalized ring-tones. I have one for you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, uh, you're just walking in normally today. It's just, I, uh... I don't have much to report. I was kinda hoping a cool lair entrance would eat up a little time.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'll be doing the heavy lifting monitoring the mainframe here and Carl will do the easy work of climbing through ten thousand feet of tunnel checking each opening.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Major Monogram. You see, I'm in charge of an elite group of secret agent undercover animals who— (clears throat) You don't mind me going on about this, do ya?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doggone it Carl, we can't keep wasting our funds like this! (to Agent P) Well anyway Agent P, I guess you can go over there and see what he's gonna do with that large bucket. (Agent P leaves)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz is at the Almond Brittle Convention, so you have the day off. I'm in nearby Swampville teaching Carl the manly art of piloting a fan boat.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The super code red emergency is that our organization, O.W.C.A., has to square off with the evil scientist organization, L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N., in a soccer game.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Uh, oop! Uh, hold on a sec. (grunts while turning his camera upside down) There we go! Doofenshmirtz has been spotted buying television cameras, boom mics, and makeup. Find out what he's up to.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I want to apologize for my appearance. You see, I was up all night monitoring Doofenshmirtz. It seems that—zzzzzzzzzzzz.... Yeah, I'll have cake.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (via a screen on a Tiki statue) Aloha, Agent P. I see you were able to subliminally persuade your host family to take their vacation in Hawaii. Still have no idea how you managed to do that.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Now for your mission. Slushy the Clown statues have disappeared all over the Tri-State Area. Without that clown, there's just nothing fun about lunch anymore.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. I hear you took a wrong tube and ended up over in Wanda's division. Well, Doofenshmirtz has sent you a video message. Take a look.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oop, good morning, Agent P. Uh...beat it, Carl. I'm on. (Carl leaves) Sources tell us that Doofenshmirtz's "ROTFL". We don't know what that means, but it sounds dangerous.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello there, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz's brother, Roger, is having another commemorative statue of himself— (scoffs) If I had a nickel for every time that's happened...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Garry the Gander? Oh, that's just a wild-goose chase. Get it? Goose, gander? Heh. Uh, we had to distract Agent P because he's too close to Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I was just doing a little handicapping for this year's Running of the Chinchillas. I think I'm going to box Dryer's Dust with Squeaky Toy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We can't let the family see him like this, he's got the brain of a toddler. We need to restore his memory before he's missed at the Father Daughter Picnic.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: At this rate, I'll be late for my creative writing class. Agent P! No need to walk all the way down here! I'll just give you your mission on the staircase!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: On behalf of the entire Agency, I'd like to thank you for your valiant service in one of our darkest hours. (places a medal and a fedora on Planty) Planty the Potted Plant, welcome to the Agency.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sure, sure. Thank you for not making us wait. Heh. That bathroom attendant was lovely, he gave me mints and some floss. I-I just couldn't thank him enough.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, thanks for coming in this evening. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted interacting with other doctors and scientists and must be up to something evil.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Never mind that, Carl. His overtime is expensive, and, you, on the other hand, are free. So stop goofing off, find Doof, and help Agent P finish up fast.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We planted hundreds of hidden cameras in Evil Incorporated (image of D.E.I. shows on monitor) so that we here at headquarters can watch the historic event and also enjoy some cheap laughs. (chuckles)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (hands out money) No! For the delivery. Even though it was 37 seconds late. But I will be sure to validate your parking. Heh. A "paid intern". That would be preposterous.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, Agent P, sources indicate Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to one of his evil schemes. I need you to get out there and put a stop to it. Good luck.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. I've got bad news and good news. The bad news is you're being reassigned to a new, more evil villain. His name: The Regurgitator.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh-oh, sorry Agent P. I guess evil never takes a holiday. If you'll direct your attention to the screen. (A screen comes on, showing him in uniform.) Good morning Agent P. A-A wise man once said...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy nine hundredth and ninety ninth lair entrance, Agent P! To commemorate this joyous occasion, we'd like to present you with this souvenir T-shirt.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Code Red! Doof's therapist is about to blow the lid off of OWCA's entire operation, exposing us all! You must stop him! (to Carl) Keep shredding, Carl!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I trust that your mission was a complete success. Good work! Now, hand it over for the special disposal procedure. Careful, now. Careful.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: When an evil scientist sends fragrant letters, wrongdoing can't be far behind. Dismissed Agent P! Carl, let me uh, smell that letter again, would ya?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I would never pull an elaborate childish prank like that. I-I-It would ruin my reputation! Destroy my credi- oh, I see where you're going with this.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, our agents are being overwhelmed by the sheer number of robots coming into our dimension. You must get to Doof's headquarters and stop him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly, Carl! This could bring down the entire organization. (straightens his mustache) Get him back to headquarters right away so that we can restore his memory.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Your 100th battle with Dr. Doofenshmirtz is already a big hit on the O.W.C.A. intranet. With five million downloads so far. You're a star, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, there, Agent P! Well, it's Horrific Movie Night at my house where a bunch of Agency guys get together and make fun of ridiculously bad movies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! A distress signal! Agent P is really trapped! Why won't he use the bevy of tools and weapons conveniently located in his hat?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Alright, everyone, take it easy. Just calm down. No reason to get upset. We've got a massive security deposit on this place. So, everybody just...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We still haven't found out who it was. In the meantime, we'll need you to bring him in. Get on it, Agent P, and, uh, take Doofenshmirtz with you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has created some sort of living cloud and we believe he may turn it into a huge storm to wash away everything he dislikes.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, you better get goin', Agent P. You can use the disguise setting on your Olson Martin. (Perry takes his Olson Martin out of his pocket, pushes a button, and it turns into Vanderbeek's mustache. He puts it on.) Wow, the resemblance is uncanny! Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Now on screen in Perry's lair) Agent P, sorry about the delay. Doofenshmirtz is at it again, he's been frequenting hobby shops and well, Carl's worried sick. Aren't you, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Oh, right! Ahem. As you know, after our agents were all captured and O.W.C.A. fell, your resistance partly operated out of our old headquarters.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've noticed an excess of plant life on Doof's balcony. We suspect it's part of a nefarious scheme. Get to the bottom of it, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What happened to that guy? No pressure, but style counts. (Perry salutes and walks away sadly) Let's, uh, let's give him a few days, and then we should talk to him about his exits.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I just completed your intern evaluation report. You've earned a gold star in every category except one. You need to show more initiative.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come in. Sit down, Agent P. We have a serious problem. It seems someone, and I'm not saying who, someone has spilled on the couch in the lobby.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I'm sure whatever Doof is up to, he's probably much warmer than we are, and that alone should be reason to stop him! Good luck, Agent P! (Perry salutes and exits his lair)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The hallway is crawling with compromised agents. We're gonna hafta do some creative sneaking, Carl. Follow my lead. (They sneak around.) The cobra. (They do a pose, while Agent C passes by, not noticing them. They start sneaking again.) Andalusian dog. (They pose again, while Agent F passes by.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What the heck is all that racket? I'm just gonna go over there and tell them to keep it down. I'll be polite but firm. (He opens the divider to reveal Doof, as a record scratch is heard, then he closes it up again.) Huh. What are the odds?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I see you got the memo. It's Transcendental Meditation Week. Namasté. (He bows and Perry bows back.) Doofenshmirtz has been spot—Carl, enough with the drumming!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry to, uh, ping your pong, Agent P, but we've received word that Doofenshmirtz has made an appointment to renew his evil business license.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Huh? Great googly moogly! Combining fighting evil with acrobatics? Of course! It was right in front of my face the whole time. That's my boy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, there you are, Agent P. Well, let's get down to brass tacks… (reading his clipboard) What's this? "Happy passive-aggressive relationship day"? Oh, is that today?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There's nothing wrong with unlicensed good, Carl. (turning to Perry) Oh, uh, since you're in the area, Carl would appreciate it if you renewed our license too.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, welcome to our telethon. If you're just joining us, your dollars are helping us to find a cure for, um... antidisestablishmentarianism.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, recent events have brought it to my attention that you're a great help to me. And, uh, not quite sure what I'd do without you, in fact.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On radio) Agent P, your halo jump is a go. Go, go, go! Jump, and fall! Keep falling, and keep being a platypus! Visualize it, you're a falling plat- (Perry turns off radio as his bubble takes shape that burns through Doofenshmirtz Evil Inc‥ He approaches Doofenshmirtz looking quh-wite unhappy)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oui, Fifi. (at himself) Oh, now I've lost my train of thought. (at Perry) Anyway, get out to Doof's place and put a stop to it. (at Carl) How much is this costing us, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's alright. (His visor drops on his eyes and he pushes it back up.) Monty, is that you?! With the daughter of my sworn enemy?! It can't be!! (Walks up to the Pimpernel next to Vanessa.) Alright, Monty, you've got a lot of explaining to— (the Pimpernel that is talking to Vanessa reveals herself to be Stacy.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, guess we can kiss that pair of handcuffs good bye. I don't about you, but I'm gonna go take in a revue. See you back in the States.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, I can see the smell from here. Put it down and test all the outside portals. Maybe the doors are stuck or something.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As you know, Doofenshmirtz is in the area of the Big Island. He's obviously up to no good. Find out what's he up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Carl) D'you know how bad it looks when you know something that I don't? Never know something that I don't. Now, Carl, where did I put my keys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, there you are. Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted playing with a hoop. See what he's up to. (Perry looks scornfully at Monogram.) That's it. That's all we got.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I thought you were joking about that. But, you know, seeing you in uniform and handing me a pizza, I admit I might be mistaken.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz has been experimenting with image technology! It's very suspicious! We need you to go check it out! Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on monitor in the ice cream truck) Remember, Carl, nothing distracts kids like ice cream. You need to get rid of those two boys so Agent P can proceed with his mission.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Like I said, we haven't come up with anything yet. So, we need you to get in there, and find out. Good luck, and be careful out there

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We, the members of the jury, find the defendant (gets zapped) not not guilty, so I guess we find him guilty. (The bailiff cuffs the defendant and takes him away.) Funny, I coulda sworn he was innocent.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I know we gave you some time off, but-but could you please come back in to work? (pleading) Please? (normal voice) I can't hold my eyes like this much longer.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You can't make me talk. I have nerves of steel and...an iron will and...gold teeth and a...copper spleen. Basically, I'm 35% metal.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: No, no. Doofenshmirtz is in jail. Everything's fine. Go-Go to your picnic and relax. Dress festive, be young! Ha. You've earned it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, what good are they to him here? Poor Agent P, he's just a platypus trapped in a cage. Wearing a tiny hat, a little fedora...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Planty the Potted Plant, but apparently your cover's been blown. I'm afraid you'll have to be repotted with another family.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't state the obvious, Carl! Anyhoo, better get over and give Doof a nudge, just to make sure he's still, uh, y'know, breathing.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Heh. Y'know, Vanessa, this reminds me of this one Fourth of July when Monty had a firecracker shoot right at—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Special surveillance photos tell us that Doof has been outfitting his skiff with something large. It's hard to tell--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: In fact, ih, why don't you come on in and enjoy a slice on me? And I've even got a special surprise for you. (gets out his wallet) You're getting paid!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, yes, I know how it goes, Carl. Anyhoo, the mayor is the public face of Danville. Do not let Doofenshmirtz ruin the ceremony.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, Agent P, who do I look like? Huh, whaddya think? (Perry simply stares) Oh c'mon! Carmen Miranda! Y'know, you really should watch more old movies.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that's it for me, Carl. The season premiere of Workplace Acquaintances is tonight, and I hear the episode is really tepid.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! (to Perry) Sorry, Agent P. Carl's been taking some film classes and now believes I'm stifling his creativity as my cameraman.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I assure you, for the rest of my life, every time I look back on this I will personally drive over to your house and smack you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This is highly irregular. I really... Can you turn the screen sideways? I really don't look good in the vertical aspect ratio.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, and we're back. We're counting down the top 10 Phineas and Ferb music videos from Season 1, as picked by you, the viewers.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (appearing in disguise with Carl, also in disguise) Oh, look! There he is! My pet bunny, Mr. Bigelow! I've been lookin' everywhere for you! Get over here, you naughty lagomorph!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh. You already got him. So it's somebody else? What kind of evil mastermind would... Heh heh. Not our problem. Monogram out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Curse your furniture-based shenanigans, Carl! (to Agent P, from the floor) Doof has done something to alter local gravity, so you should go check it out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that was trippy. Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted doing a variety of non-evil things, maniacally.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Okay, you made your point, Parenthesis. Apparently, I didn't notice you in school. Sad story. Boo-hoo. But why are you here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P-HEE! Whoo! Sorry, we haven't cleaned that entrance in a while. Don't worry, we have a moist towelette.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Unguessable? It's basic meteorology! You're going to upset the existing cloud's warm front by hitting it with a cold front.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyhoo, Doofenshmirtz hasn't left his house in over 36 hours, so maybe do a wellness check. Make sure he's hale and hearty.

Name: Bad Future Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, another failed mission. It's gotten really hard to defeat Doofenshmirtz ever since we swore that oath to obey him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Remember the three D's. "Distraction", "Discussion", or "Diversion". Make a "Decision". Nope, four. I guess there are four.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can see that Carl, now get back in that corner until I tell you you can get up. Still fifteen minutes left on the timer.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I do have 24 hours before I have to submit my evaluation. Prove you can show initiative and that gold star is yours.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Our analysts agree: Evil, chicken wings, underwater, 15%. It's a recipe for disaster. It's up to you to stop him, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! What's wrong? Oh! You caught Doofenshmirtz, huh? That's weird. Usually he traps you, then you escape and then...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tries to grab the pizza box) Well, Carl, if you hadn't wasted your evening with all your silly antics, maybe you'd be able to deliver a pizza on time.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Pretty sure there's a small town half a klick north. Or is it south? Eh, it probably doesn't matter. Just try to keep up.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We really miss that clown. (sniffles) So, ahem, drop whatever you're doing and find out what happened to those statues by lunchtime.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's better. Sorry to be so harsh, Agent P, but today is a very special day. Your 100th battle with Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not now, Carl. I'm briefing Agent P. (at Perry) So get out there and good hunting. (Perry leaves) Oh, no! Carl uh, now it just says q-q-q-q-q-q-q.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. Your monitor is on the fritz today...thanks to someone who isn't aware that croquet is an outdoor game.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry. We need you to infiltrate his headquarters. Carl thinks I need to be more "inclusive". Find out what he's up to!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's why you'll be controlling this robotic version of Mr. Fletcher. (He carries Perry up and into the robot.) Unfortunately, the operation manual is in Dutch. (Gives Perry the foreign manual.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Is everything all right, Agent P? I'm sensing you're in a bit of a jam. Can you get us a better view of the situation?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from inside) Alright, everybody, tall kids in the back. (zooms to the inside of the lab) Just need to do a little more programming here, and we'll be ready to roll.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (On Perry's motorcycle's side mirror) Agent P. We just received word you're on Canadian soil. We don't have jurisdiction there. Stand down! That's an order!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, this new facility is really impressive. Now, tell me again where you found the money for all these improvements.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. (Lawrence gasps and hides behind the hovercar) Doofenshmirtz has been doing lots of research on the structural properties of glue. It's probably not... (continues under)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, I'm afraid your robotic Mr. Fletcher is overheating. Apparently, Carl forgot to top off the coolant levels.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Ah, well, I didn't want to say anything before, but we kind of lost track of some of the agents when Doof took over.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh no, Agent P! It's stuck in their heads! We need something even more catchy to counteract it! But what could we...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Is that what I look like?! Wow, suddenly I feel ridiculous. Never mind, Carl, you can have it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, no, the more spice, the better! Ooh, maybe spices from, uh, another room. Like, uh, really-hard-to-find spices.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Yeah, well, um, now that we're trying to rebuild our spy network, I was wondering, um, where did you put the keys?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The terrain is too treacherous. You're going to have to parachute. Here's your parachute, goggles and oxygen mask.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Rrrright, we think it might be a switch, but we don't know what it's for so, we need your help. Good luck Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You really think you'll be a part of all of this? He's playing you like a penny whistle in a really bad jazz band.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Then something's not right because OWCA is infested with fleas. Carl, activate emergency flea protocol 993-alpha.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, (Perry holds up a finger to signify "wait a minute") Agent P, you must abort your current mission! There is something much more important than Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl? Carl! Oh, no, they must be torturing that poor kid. Don't worry, little unpaid intern, help is on the way.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I can't believe I let myself get talked into this. It's embarrassing and, if I'm being honest, a bit drafty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. we just found out that Doofenshmirtz is scouring the Tri-State Area for some sort of an on-off device.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (tearing up) Congratulations, Agent P! I knew it couldn't be you causing all that trouble! (sobs) You are officially... reinstated!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we've finished restoring Mr. Fletcher's memory. You need to distract the girl so we can make the swap.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! Something terrible has happened. Listen carefully; these straws are about to collapse like a flimsy...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes yes, the uh next 15 minutes should be a real hoot. Well then, of course, Agent P will be sent away forever.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. I see you're trying out the new SFU 2000. It's a lot of fun, but don't let your duties slide.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh... I promised Carl you'd get him one of those hula wigglers for his dashboard. He thinks it would be "neat."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hang tight, Agent P. Backup is on the way. I mean, it would be, if we had some. Uh, I'm gonna make some calls.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You came in a little late there, Carl. Get back over there. We'll try it again. (Clears throat) Blah, blah, blah, the power of

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P? Hello, Agent P? Agent P? (At Carl) Carl, he does know this is scheduled for this morning, doesn't he?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good luck, young man! (they leave) We could use someone like him at the Agency. Carl, why don't we have a soundtrack band?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P. Come in, Agent P. Oh, good, you're all right. We need your help. OWCA's on lockdown. We're trapped!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All of our other agents are busy out in the field. If-If only there was a way to get these tools to Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We have to assume evil intent, though, because that's what pays the bills around here. Thwart away, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, children. Carl, uh, your mother and I were worried when you didn't come home. Uh, are you in trouble?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, Agent P, I think everyone would like to know, what are your thoughts on the videos we've seen tonight?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you're a solid B+ student with a promising future. What could you possibly have to gain from all this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Um, uh, Doof's doing something in City Hall, puh-put a stop to whatever it is. (running after Carl) Hey Carl, I get the blue one!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes! Now that I'm back in my old clothes, uniformy or not. I predict the Nehru jacket will make a comeback.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Look, I'm getting messages from some diabolically clever hacker, who goes by the sinister initials "TTYL".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just trying to put a happy face on it, Carl. Doofenshmirtz has been spotted on a... boat. Go check it out. (Perry leaves)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And I think that sets up our next music video perfectly. Here it is thanks to your votes, video number 5!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! You can't keep us cooped up in here. Though the self-serve smoothie machine is a welcome diversion.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, you've saved this organization. If there's anything we can do for you in return, don't hesitate.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nice work, Agent P. Carl's analyzing the footprint sample you pulled from Doof's living room as we speak.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (with lots of unshaven hairs on his face) I can't believe you forgot to pick up new razors, Carl! Now I have to go on camera without a clean shave!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry for the lair entrance power outage, Agent P, but someone plugged a hairdryer into the wrong outlet.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (cont'd) And the only thing worse than regular evil is unlicensed evil. So make sure he does the proper paperwork.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Hang on, hang on. It's here somewhere on this clipboard from which I have yet to look up.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: (on screen) Well, that's impossible. He's right here in our detention facility. I-I-I just played checkers with him. (He cheats, by the way.)

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: We've had Doofenshmirtz moved into this interrogation room so Candace Flynn can question him thoroughly.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy Harbor Day, Agent P! In honor of the occasion, we've flooded your headquarters. Hope you like it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, none, but, would it kill you to at least look the part? You look like a preschool crossing guard.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nobody cares, Carl! (to Agent P) I'm meeting my son's girlfriend for the first time. Why don't you join us, Agent P?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Duh, it's his whole shtick. It's on the side of his building. Anyway, Agent P, go do what it is you do.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Actually, I was kinda havin' fun, too. Heh heh. Nevertheless, this isn't a situation to make light of.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Huh. You may have some cleverly concealed singing chops, but to me, you'll always be an unpaid intern.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Kids, I'm sorry, but now that Agent P's cover has been blown, you won't be allowed to see him anymore.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh Agent P, you look adorable as a balloon animal. Now, get out there and laissez le bon temps rouler. ("Let the good times roll.")

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes. It's because you're so unlike the son that I did have! And here he is. Come on over here, Monty!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, well, look at that. (He hides Carl) Seems they just found a cure. Thanks to all the viewers who donated. Bye now.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We're going to be fine. In dire situations, you must rely on your manly man instincts. Now follow me.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hmmm. Nevermind, Carl. It's showtime! (Cut to the stage) Hello, everyone! Welcome to the O.W.C.A. Graduation Ceremony!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I already told you your name's not that cool. Anyway, do your stuff, Agent P, and stop that- DOOF! (Laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There, you see? A little gratitude goes a long way. Pay attention Carl, you could learn something.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, when you're finished with Agent P's team on the backlot, return to headquarters immediately.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come on, we got to get out of here. We'll just use the jet's big magnet to pick up all this stuff.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fine. But after we get her back, you're going to have to answer for what you've done here, mister.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Cheese and crackers! Oh, excuse me, you two... But uh...should that button be blinking like that?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, sorry, Agent P. I, uh... (clears throat) We're testing all the lair entrances while Doof is away on vacation.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're absolutely right! We gotta strip down to our skivvies and shelter under shack over there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, any intel? Doofenshmirtz is clearly using his daughter as a pawn to infiltrate O.W.C.A.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (sarcastically) Sure you are. Agent P still hasn't finished his mission and our trackers show he's in your area.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm very proud of you, Carl. But my feelings for you can be better expressed in your evaluation.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey, Agent P. Carl, give me a close up. So, uh, anyway... Stop Doofenshmirtz. (at Carl) Hit it, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, and... and as of this moment, I am officially promoting you to the title of "Paid Intern."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz?! Are you here to ruin my classy evening out with my son and his new girlfriend?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Anyway, we need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. (Perry salutes) Good luck, Agent P. (The chopper comes out of his seat and he flies away.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I guess that's that. We should get that remote device and... (looks inside the body) Whoa! (the robot body grabs Monogram, and pushes Carl, and Perry onto the sofa.) Oh, no, I can't. (The robot body lifts Monogram up in the air so he can see inside.) What?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Bookcase entrance. (puts down magazine) Got it. Keep it going, Carl. That's, uh... 1% done. We got a lot more to do.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good idea. Ahem. Me first, me first. Uh, let's see. "When I wake up in the morning sun..."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: First, the flea collars don't work and now fogging doesn't take? What kind of fleas are these?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, the Flynn-Fletchers are on their return route home! Stop your tomfoolery and wrap it up!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't worry, sir. No one will know it's us. We're registered as the "Capulet Bat Mitzvah".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted at Droogenfest. He's probably just there to celebrate.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yeah, and, uh, aren't you a little too three-dimensional to host an animated show, young lady?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, don't throw out my burrito ends! If I put them together, I can make a whole new burrito!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Whoa! He snuck the fleas into OWCA Headquarters by hiding them in a shipment of flea collars.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A bunch of expertly trained athletic field agents versus some haphazard scientists? (chuckles) I am in.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm in here! (Perry turns and moves to side of the vent Major Monogram is in, and puts his fedora on) Sorry for the break-in protocol, but this is urgent. Show him the photo, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Very good, sir. This year's event will be held at the Knights of Danville Hall, Ballroom B.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) In a crisis, rely on your own unique skill set. For instance, Carl here knows how to yo-yo.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And all of the agents are being controlled by a sinister being named Professor Parenthesis.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry about the distraction, Agent P. The ladies are helping to, uh, (reading from a card) "net-roy-er the lair."

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, I told you. There's nothing funny about a man in his underwear skating into a toilet.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voiceover) Doonie Do-Good knows it's his responsibility to step in and use any skills he has to help.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And it keeps going like that for another twenty minutes. Get to the bottom of it, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He's my guest and now my backup. No son of mine will date the daughter of my mortal enemy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, are you that kid who wore that Robin Hood hat and passed out in the drinking fountain?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well, I'll have to fix that then. Carl, run out and buy me a new set of encyclopedias.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (talking from a screen set into the bone) Psst. Agent P. Agent P. (Perry puts on his fedora) Down here. (Camera zooms into the bone) It's the new dog bone communicator. Pretty clever, huh?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on wrist communicator) Agent P, Doof found Agent S's weakness. We need you to drop everything and return to duty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well done, team! You've earned those black hat bands. You are now officially OWCA agents!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Not yet, Carl. Wait till I'm done here. (to Perry) You are officially.. discharged. (to Carl) Okay, now, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz, you would be nothing without O.W.C.A. foiling your evil, ridiculous ploys.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Morning, Agent P. We've intercepted some very surprising footage from a local TV station. (Plays video)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (After spotting a large box of straws) Hmm, that gives me an idea. And this time, a good idea. Not like the one I had about the—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Great googly moogly! You're not Agent P! I mean, uh, that is... Look over there!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good thing we found a hiding place, Carl. What is this? A dining room table or something?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, I didn't know you were a germaphobe. (at Carl) Carl, he's afraid of germs, just like you.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P. You'll come back on the jet with us. Obviously, we can't have you...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What? Oh, the hot tub. Purely therapeutic. The bubbles work wonders on a bad back. (The bubbles stop) Carl!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, you're fine, Carl. Not everything's about you, you know. (A beeping sound is heard. Monogram pushes a button on the TV monitor beneath him and a highly decorated colonel appears onscreen.) Hello, Colonel Contraction.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: And by a totally unrelated coincidence, Doofenshmirtz will be there. Keep an eye on him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Isn't that something you should've checked before we crawled through all that duct work?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good work, Agent P! Now we just need you to...Oh, okay, yeah, you got that covered, too.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're lucky I'm exercising boundaries. Otherwise, you'd be burnt toast, Doofenshmirtz!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P! Over here! Oh, good; you got my message. There's no time to lose we have to...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we have a situation. Dennis the Rogue Agent, formerly our most wanted rodent—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh. I didn't become a major so I could sweat out a vaudeville routine with an intern.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nope, far too dangerous. And besides, our insurance won't cover it. Tell 'em, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The only dip here is you, Carl. Sorry, Agent P. Tonight's the finale of Acquaintances.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well then, let me just say thank you, to the chef. Thank you for that delicious meal.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Doof) Hmm, about the, uh, hugging when we were at death's door. I wasn't myself back there.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This smells like a setup. Carl, consider yourself back on the clock. Pull up a chair.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Congratulations, Agent P! You've won an all-expense paid trip to... (to Carl) Drumroll, please.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No! No, I'm not! And if you happen to be looking for the beach, Carl, (flexes) it's that way.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, don't worry young lady. You'll be able to continue your vacation in 10–20 years.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Howdy, Agent P. Doof's been experimenting with recombinant DNA. And it isn't pretty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hm, we need to send someone in undercover. All the agents are out on their missions. (upbeat theme plays)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, we were... Wait a minute. (close-up of the zoo platypus) You're not (beat) in uniform, agent! Where is your hat?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Let's face it. You've done more damage inside the Agency than you ever did outside.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (offscreen) Uh, Carl, how does the escape hatch work with, you know, this whole lockdown thing?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, right. Anyway, Parenthesis is using robot fleas to control our agents' minds...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Dr. Doofenshmirtz, that information is highly classified and strictly confidential.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Singsong) Mommy-mi-moe-moo. Blah-blah-blah-blah-blah. Me-ma-moe-moo-my-pa. (Clears throat) Ma-moe-mee-ma-moo.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great! Agent P is the best we have. If anyone can get that team in shape, it's him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What -- what -- what? They get to go? What is this, Pick On the Higher Species Day?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh-oh, Agent P. It turns out Carl was lying about getting you that Sal Tuscany CD.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, you think that, Carl. You're a Capricorn. You know what to do, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I mean, seriously. I'm growing mushrooms under here. (He sniffs himself) I don't smell too bad, do I?

Name: Major Monogram's Voice
Dialog: Agent Pinky is good with computers...good with computers...good with computers...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He was a family friend. Now get on the plane, we've got a Tri-State Area to save.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Doof has apparently slept through the day's opportunity for evil.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, well I didn't realize I hadn't. Thank you for pointing that out to me Monty.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (In a shocked tone) You mean we're not in Egypt? I thought those pyramids were kind of stair-steppy.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, for Pete's sake, Heinz! Evil Carl must be stopped. We have to work together.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey, hang on. Say, what kind of an evil scheme you got going on there today?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry you had to see that, Agent P. Please find out what Doofenshmirtz is up to!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz? What are you doing here? Did you finally come here to surrender?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It took us all morning to hand-squeeze those lemons. And by "us", I mean Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Monty here just graduated from HSWACA! The High School Without A Cool Acronym.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You've been a bad little bunny. (walks off with Carl) Now let's get you back to your...special room.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning Agent P. We've received some disturbing calls from Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: These are the stories of the agents of the O.W.C.A. These are the OWCA Files!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, the Tri-State Area has been taken over! Stop Doof immediately and...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why are you winking? And you know you don't have to say "wink" when you wink.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that doesn't look good. You can clearly see your zipper in the costume!

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: The what?! Was one of them a panda and the other one of those shaky rat dogs?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No excuses. Agent P is going into triple overtime and OWCA will be bankrupt.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm standing here with Cindy, an animated member of our studio audience who-

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's right, it's P to the P, P-squared, or as I like to call him, Agent P!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Leaving just a Bi-State Area? (shudders, to Agent P) Whatta ya waitin' for, Agent P?! Go after him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Why Is That Ferret Wearing a Fedora?" An OWCA Guide for Those in the Know.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (appears on his car's monitor) Agent P, we're gonna need you to pull an all-night stakeout over at Doof's.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He always forgets to turn off the lights! I'll just get it with the remote.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get out there and find out what Doof is up to. (At Carl) Seriously Carl? What a baby.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (voice-over) Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys. Stop Doofenshmirtz. Protect the boys.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: So our only leads are coffee and the rainy climate. That could be anywhere!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: There you are, Agent P. Hope you're enjoying that fresh glass of lemonade.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, It's a shame he couldn't save the table too. Let's go find the host--

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What the..? (at Carl) Hey, Carl! It's back! Look how great it... (moves; realizes the mustache isn't on his face but on the screen) Oh. (taps the screen) Oh, doggone it!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, I don't know about you guys, but I've got a good feeling about this!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Tubular. If I had been wearing socks, they would've been rocked right off.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, speaking of leftovers, Carl, clean out the break room fridge, will ya?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. there you are. Merry Christmas. Oh great, you brought snacks.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He did? Heh. Well, good for him. Well, I guess we're done. I'm going home.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You've got to keep that robot under control until we can make the switch. (Perry salutes.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nice upholstery job, Agent P! We got this guy. You take down Parenthesis.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No one at the Agency will ever believe that I dropped that water balloon.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can't find Monty. Get up on my shoulders, Carl! See if you can see him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: It's just a hat, Carl. Why is it just a hat? Do you think he's invisible?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, hello, Agent- No! Not you! (While Dennis begins hacking the mainframe) Agent P, you have to stop him before he...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wow, bad time for that. You totally left me hanging in that cliff scene.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait, Carl? What in blazes are you doing here?! And who are these guys?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hey, Parenthesis, I wouldn't get too comfortable if I were you. Heh heh.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (after a pause) You know, Carl, it's weird that he is not an animal. (Pauses) We should fire him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, I see you found the new central air conditioning entrance.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ugh. We were hoping to get another couple of years out of that couch...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, I see! Improper punctuation. Say, how is Agent P's team shaping up?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, commercial's over. My show's about to start. Just get to it, Carl. (hangs up)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, your cover's been blown! We're going to have to relocate you!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! That would blow your cover with your host family!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (off screen) Carl! How many times have I told you, lift the seat when you're done?! (Monogram rises on his seat.)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You realize you could have just called him yourself, you do work here.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Atta boy, now come on over here and let me out. We have to follow him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That thing's not gonna do us any good, if we don't survive the flight.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't know what happened, Carl, but our cafeteria officially stinks.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: W-wait-wait a minute. You anticipated a specific situation like this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Happy Birthday, Agent P! (blows into kazoo) (awkward pause) It's not your birthday, is it? (Perry shakes his head) Are we close?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, it is. It, um, makes you look pale and weak, (He shows Carl) like this young lad.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just do it, Carl! And watch the hair. Take these. (Carl gets on Monogram's shoulders and takes the binoculars.) Now what do ya see?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, the Marsh Maneuver. Ooh, I haven't seen one of those since 1974.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, yes. From, uh, from time to time, I like to strum the (speaks the Hawaiian pronunciation) ukulele.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (To Carl) I'll take care of it. (To Stacy) Oh, hello there young teenager. You live here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P, uh... ahem. Carl and I made a bet, and, well... I lost. (Clears throat)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Of course, what was I thinking? Don't be rude Carl, thank the chef.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, there's a list of outstanding violations as long as your arm.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Alright, O.W.C.A., this is for the honor of the agency. Drill time!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, there you... Uh-oh. Carl, I think we have a breach of security.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Wakes up)—Up all night, uh, building inators. See what he's-- zzzzzzzzzz....

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You know how Agent P feels about his chair— (He grunts as he falls over backwards.) Carl, where's my chair?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Were you the kid who got his chin stuck in that graduated cylinder?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: "Why do I think he's evil". Have you ever even watched this show?!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, isn't it time that we talked about the elephant in the room?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Uh, Agent P, we've teleported you three feet too far to the right.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You understand we won't actually be paying you. It's just a title.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, that should be easy then. Please enjoy music video number 2.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're not the only one who can rock an awesome face mullet, Fury!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, it's because I have a list of complaints from Human Resources.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, what took you so long? Hand me that report there would you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on Perry's wristwatch communicator) Agent P, come in! Agent P? Blast it, Carl, why doesn't he answer?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No no! We don't have time for an emotionally scarring back-story.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: They can't interact with the material world, Carl. Use your head!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Gets up and walks off-screen) For crying out loud, Carl. (Carl is seen pedaling the generator, panting) Pedal faster. I gotta check my e-mail.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Carl) Carl!? Why didn't we just look out the window in the first place?

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Huh. Maybe I just don't know how this one-way mirror thing works.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (his head appears beside Perry) Remember, if your cover's blown, you'll never see the boys again.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'd try to recruit him but I don't think we have a hat that big.

Name: Major Monogram-2
Dialog: Carl will be helping me locate our animal agents so that we can—

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: All right! Here's a little ditty I like to call "Song Number 7"!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Anyway, Agent P, you can take it easy and enjoy a Doof-free day.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I really like that character; is there gonna be more about him?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Keep fanning, Carl! Lunch isn't for another forty-five minutes!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Fantastical. (To Doofenshmirtz) Say, Doofenshmirtz, what'cha working on over here?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Keep a close eye on those boys. See what else you can find out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, they're here in Africa. Home is where the heart is, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Don't worry, Kelly. I am totally down for being second banana.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, Agent P isn't done and you're literally clowning around!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Triangles. And make it snappy. (pauses) I got the urge to pop and lock.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hello, Agent P. That portrait turned out great, didn't it?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Do we have any agents on the outside? Anyone without a collar?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, come on! That goal is not regulation size! Enough of this!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mayday! Mayday! (static) Use your monotreme instincts to find us! Whoa! (static)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P? Agent P, this is no time for decorating-- (looks at monitor) Ooh, I see.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get over there ASAP. Just... maybe do it on an empty stomach.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ooh, and Agent P, could– Could you do it dressed as a… Bunny? (He laughs)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl! Stop filming your butt, film mine. It's a party! Wahey!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, Carl? Did you tell him the accelerator's a little touchy?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (Overlapping him) What did I say about contradicting me in front of the agents?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, here's a deaf jam that's really kicking it old school.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: As for me, I'm off to Cheesetopia! (Shows Carl a Cheesetopia poster.) It's Utopia, with cheese!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh! Agent W pulled a muscle! (to Carl) Get the stretcher! The big one!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: That's because he's not officially an employee, he's unpaid.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Be careful out there... (looks at Carl) ...washing my car. Don't scratch it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (looking at his watch) And not a minute too soon. (gives thumbs up) Good luck, Agent P. Monogram out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, thank you so much. I—Mmmm, what is that wonderful smell?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Where's Agent P? You set off the wrist beacon, right, Carl?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: A desk we can both hide under? Whose office is this anyway?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, right. I forgot Agent W is missing. Go, young lady, go!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Uh, I've been cleared by doctors. Anyways, good luck, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well. I stand corrected. That was actually very convincing.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Well, but not at the moment. (To Carl) Carl, how are my socks coming?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're not that guy who kept eating his own hair, are you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (from the water spout) Next time you're stuck, I don't wanna hear about it, Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, is that why I signed an invoice for an echo machine?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: The more you protest, the more we know you gave it to him.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly-moogly! (He slides down off-screen) Do... (cut to the camera room where Carl is shown piloting the camera.) Carl. Carl, who are those kids?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Welcome to the best noodle house in Shanghai.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Come on, Carl. Let's get outta here! (he opens the door, but it is blocked) Carl, what the heck?!

Name: Major Monogram
